title: SignalCard
description: A single fraud-signal card. Every pillar (spend/shift/voice) produces these. Dashboard renders them.

signal_id.description: Unique within a case. Suggested format: {pillar}-{signal_type}-{facility_id}-{line_id}

signal_type.description: Within-pillar kind. spend: ref_price_delta | ownership_overlap | volume_sanity. shift: license_collision | credential_validity | impossible_travel. voice: attestation_mismatch.

headline.description: One-line human summary, under 120 chars. Rendered as the card title.

detail.description: Optional multi-line human detail, rendered on card expand.

evidence.description: Pillar-specific free-form evidence. See examples below.

citation.description: Where the underlying data came from. Rendered as footer link.

chain_commit.description: Present iff this signal's hash was anchored on-chain. Rendered as a 'View on Basescan/Solana Explorer' badge.
